depiction_rules.notes: D027 scene-specific Brahma continuity; four heads and four arms are intentional.

visual_bible.age: mature divine creator, calm and dignified
visual_bible.faces: four heads total; three faces visible from front and fourth turned behind
visual_bible.clothing: warm cream and muted saffron, restrained ornaments
visual_bible.attributes: four separate hands may hold scripture, lotus, water pot and beads

anatomy_contract.rule: all heads and arms distinct and attached; fourth head faces behind

never: no more or fewer than four heads or arms
identity_scope: D027 scene continuity only; not an approved character master
